normalization_fit: training episodes only, excludes internal holdout and all validation/test data
loss: MSE over [linear_speed, angular_speed/2], weight 3 for abs(angular_speed)>0.2 rad/s else 1

config.filter: keep only pre-arrival trajectories of robots that finish in a collision-free episode; retain successful individual robots in timeout episodes; discard all samples from collision episodes
config.internal_holdout: whole training episodes with layout index modulo 5 equal to 0; never split adjacent frames
config.checkpoint_selection: first four frozen validation layouts: maximum team success then minimum capped completion then minimum internal holdout MSE
config.arrival_stop_note: same deterministic distance stop as Classical; no classical obstacle avoidance or safety filter during BC inference

note: G2 validation selection, not held-out test performance; seed 0 only; other training seeds remain for G4
